description: A Severance 400 bolted to the wall. The amber screen lists bounties, name and price. Feed the coin slot to post one of your own. Down at floor level is a round stainless port: put a head in it and the machine weighs it and pays. PAYABLE ON DELIVERY. DO NOT INSERT LIVING TISSUE.

receptacle.accept: The port cycles slowly, thinking about it, and takes it. The machine makes the noise it would make for a gas bill.
receptacle.dark: The port won't open. The terminal is dead, and Bishop's hasn't noticed.
receptacle.darkPost: Nothing in the terminal is running. The cafe is going to keep on not mentioning it.
receptacle.empty: A contract pays on delivery, and the port isn't for your hand.
receptacle.room: {handle} crouches at the terminal by the wall. It thinks for a while, then counts out {amount}, and a man two tables away turns a page.

name: bounty terminal
